Definition: Malki-Tsedek, an early king in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Melchizedek, king of Salem, was the priest of the most high God who met Abraham with bread and wine in Genesis 14:18, and Psalms 110:4 swears the Messiah shall be a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek. His name means king of righteousness, and he stands alone in the record, with no father and no mother named.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Melchizedek is the hinge between the testaments: a king and priest with no genealogy, whose order outlasts Aaron's.
